arguments.command:
cd /tmp && python3 << 'EOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp')
if 'parse_new5' in sys.modules:
    del sys.modules['parse_new5']

from parse_new5 import Parser, search, parse

# Check patterns first
p1 = Parser('{:<}', case_sensitive=True)
print(f"{{:<}} pattern: {p1._search_re.pattern}")

p2 = Parser('{:.^}', case_sensitive=True)
print(f"{{:.^}} pattern: {p2._search_re.pattern}")

p3 = Parser('{:<10}', case_sensitive=True)
print(f"{{:<10}} pattern: {p3._search_re.pattern}")

# Test R9 cases
tests = [
    ('{:<}', 'hello world', 'hello'),
    ('{:<}', 'hello   ', 'hello'),
]

print("\nTesting R9 alignment behavior:")
for fmt, s, expected in tests:
    r = search(fmt, s)
    result = r.fixed[0] if r else None
    status = "PASS" if result == expected else "FAIL"
    print(f"  search({fmt!r}, {s!r}) -> {result!r} (expected {expected!r}) [{status}]")
EOF
